DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KISARAZU-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KISARAZU-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 口座を開設する目的を教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KISARAZU-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Could you tell me your purpose for opening an account?

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KISARAZU-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KISARAZU-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 新しい会社の給与を受け取るためです。この案内を見て来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KISARAZU-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 給与受け取りのため会社の案内を持参したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KISARAZU-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: To receive my salary from my new company. I came after reading this guidance.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KISARAZU-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you brought your company's guidance to open an account for receiving your salary. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KISARAZU-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KISARAZU-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 案内には別の銀行名が書かれています。当行の名前ではありませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KISARAZU-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The guidance names a different bank. It is not our bank's name.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KISARAZU-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KISARAZU-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 駅の近くにある銀行なら、どこでもこの案内どおり作れると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KISARAZU-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 案内の銀行名を見ず近くの銀行へ来たと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KISARAZU-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought any bank near the station could open an account according to this guidance.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KISARAZU-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you came to a nearby bank without checking the bank name in the guidance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KISARAZU-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KISARAZU-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 勤務先が銀行を指定しているのか、どの銀行でもよいのかを確認した方がよさそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KISARAZU-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: It would be best to check whether your employer specifies a bank or allows any bank.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KISARAZU-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KISARAZU-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。会社に聞くまで、こちらで口座開設を進めないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KISARAZU-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 会社の銀行指定を確認するまで開設を保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KISARAZU-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. Please do not proceed with opening an account here until I ask my company.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KISARAZU-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Put account opening on hold until you check whether your company specifies a bank. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KISARAZU-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KISARAZU-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。指定がなければ、当行の口座について改めてご相談いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KISARAZU-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Certainly. If no bank is specified, you may consult us again about opening an account here.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KISARAZU-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KISARAZU-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: もし指定の銀行へ行く場合も、必要な書類や予約はその銀行に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KISARAZU-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 指定先の受付条件はその銀行に確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KISARAZU-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: If I go to a specified bank, I will ask that bank about the required documents and appointments too.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KISARAZU-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will check the specified bank's reception requirements directly with that bank. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KISARAZU-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KISARAZU-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、他行の受付条件をこちらで確約することはできません。会社の案内も持って相談してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KISARAZU-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, we cannot guarantee another bank's requirements here. Take your company's guidance when you consult them too.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KISARAZU-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KISARAZU-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。まず会社に銀行指定の有無を聞き、相談する銀行を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KISARAZU-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 会社への確認後に相談先を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KISARAZU-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. First I will ask my company whether a bank is specified, then decide which bank to consult.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KISARAZU-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide which bank to consult after checking with your company. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KISARAZU-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KISARAZU-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。本日は開設を進めず、勤務先への確認後に必要な相談を行ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KISARAZU-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. We will not proceed with opening an account today. Please make the necessary inquiries after checking with your employer.

DLG-SC-CHB-NARITA-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-CHB-NARITA-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どちらまで行かれますか。
DLG-SC-CHB-NARITA-001-SHARED-01.translation: Where would you like to go?

DLG-SC-CHB-NARITA-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-CHB-NARITA-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 空港駅までお願いします。ホテルの予約にも空港駅と書いてあります。
DLG-SC-CHB-NARITA-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 駅ではなくホテルへ行きたいことを明確にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-CHB-NARITA-001-SHARED-02.translation: Airport Station, please. My hotel reservation also says Airport Station.
DLG-SC-CHB-NARITA-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Clarify that you want to go to the hotel rather than the station. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-CHB-NARITA-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-CHB-NARITA-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 駅で降りる予定ですか。それともホテルへ直接向かいますか。
DLG-SC-CHB-NARITA-001-SHARED-03.translation: Are you planning to get out at the station, or go directly to the hotel?

DLG-SC-CHB-NARITA-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-CHB-NARITA-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ホテルへ行きたいです。駅からの案内を、ホテルの住所だと思ってしまいました。
DLG-SC-CHB-NARITA-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 予約のアクセス案内と住所を取り違えたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-CHB-NARITA-001-SHARED-04.translation: I want to go to the hotel. I mistook the directions from the station for the hotel's address.
DLG-SC-CHB-NARITA-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you confused the reservation's access directions with the address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-CHB-NARITA-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-CHB-NARITA-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ホテルの名前と住所が分かる画面を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-CHB-NARITA-001-SHARED-05.translation: Could you show me a screen with the hotel's name and address?

DLG-SC-CHB-NARITA-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-CHB-NARITA-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、このメールです。同じ名前の別館もあるので、予約した本館の方を確認してください。
DLG-SC-CHB-NARITA-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ホテル名が同じ別館と本館を区別して予約を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-CHB-NARITA-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, here is the email. There is also an annex with the same name, so please check that it is the main building I booked.
DLG-SC-CHB-NARITA-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show your reservation while distinguishing the main building from an annex with the same hotel name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-CHB-NARITA-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-CHB-NARITA-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの予約は本館ですね。駅までの移動ではなく、この住所まで行くご希望でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-CHB-NARITA-001-SHARED-07.translation: This reservation is for the main building. You want to go to this address rather than just to the station, correct?

DLG-SC-CHB-NARITA-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-CHB-NARITA-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。友人は駅にいるのですが、今日は迎えに寄らず、私だけホテルへ直接行きます。
DLG-SC-CHB-NARITA-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人のいる駅には寄らず直行すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-CHB-NARITA-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. My friend is at the station, but today I will go straight to the hotel on my own without stopping to pick them up.
DLG-SC-CHB-NARITA-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will go directly without stopping at the station where your friend is. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-CHB-NARITA-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-CHB-NARITA-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。経由地はなしですね。荷物もこちらに積む物だけでしょうか。
DLG-SC-CHB-NARITA-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. No stops along the way. Is this also all the luggage to load?

DLG-SC-CHB-NARITA-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-CHB-NARITA-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: このスーツケース一つです。乗る前にホテルまでの料金の目安も聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-CHB-NARITA-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 荷物の数を示し出発前に料金の目安を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-CHB-NARITA-001-SHARED-10.translation: Just this one suitcase. Before getting in, I would also like an estimated fare to the hotel.
DLG-SC-CHB-NARITA-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give the number of bags and ask for a fare estimate before departure. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-CHB-NARITA-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-CHB-NARITA-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 行き先と道路状況を確認して目安をご案内します。ご確認後に出発しましょう。
DLG-SC-CHB-NARITA-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will check the destination and road conditions and give you an estimate. Let us leave after you have checked it.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日は書類の内容についてのご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Today you would like advice about the documents' contents, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。持ってきた原本を全部こちらに置いて帰れば、手続きが始まりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 原本を預ければ手続きが始まるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. If I leave all the originals I brought here and go home, will the procedure begin?
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether leaving the originals will start the procedure. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この場面の窓口は相談を行います。原本を預けただけで正式な手続きが始まるわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: In this situation, this counter provides consultation. Leaving originals here does not by itself start a formal procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 提出先も同じだと思っていました。まず、どの窓口へ何を出すか教えてほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 相談窓口と提出先を区別して案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought this was also the submission destination. First, please tell me what to submit at which counter.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the consultation counter from the submission destination and ask for guidance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 申請の種類を確認しましょう。この案内のどの手続きをお考えですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check the application type. Which procedure in this guidance are you considering?

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 青い印を付けた項目です。隣の項目とは違うので、必要な書類を混ぜないで確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 対象の手続きだけに絞って書類を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: The item I marked in blue. It differs from the one beside it, so I want to check the required documents without mixing them up.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to focus on the relevant procedure alone when checking documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 分かりました。原本はお客様が保管し、相談では案内と書類の種類を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. You will keep the originals, and during consultation we will check the guidance and document types.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分からない日本語に印を付けてあります。その部分の意味も説明してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 不明な日本語の説明を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have marked the Japanese I do not understand. Could you explain what those parts mean too?
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for explanations of Japanese you do not understand. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、説明します。正式な受付条件や提出方法は、担当窓口へ確認する必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, I will explain. Formal acceptance requirements and submission methods need to be checked with the responsible counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。今日は原本を持ち帰り、提出先と不明な部分をメモしてから連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 原本を持ち帰り提出先への質問を整理すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. Today I will take the originals home and contact them after noting the submission destination and unclear parts.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to take the originals home and organize your questions for the submission destination. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。対象の手続きを確認し、問い合わせ先と質問を整理しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Let us identify the relevant procedure and organize the contact details and questions.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらのページでよろしいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this the page you would like?

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。あ、帳面を逆向きに渡したかもしれません。まだ書かないでいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 帳面を逆向きに渡した可能性から記入を止める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Oh, I may have handed you the book upside down. Could you please not write yet?
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Stop writing because you may have handed over the book upside down. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まだ筆を入れていません。表紙の向きと、希望のページを一緒に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I have not put the brush to the page yet. Let us check the cover's orientation and your preferred page together.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この表紙が上です。空いている所ならどこでもいいと思いましたが、順番があるんでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 表紙の向きを示しページの順序を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: This cover is the top. I thought any empty space was fine, but is there a page order?
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the cover's orientation and check the page order. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 帳面の使い方には違いがあります。この場面では、お客様の希望を伺ってから記します。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: People use these books in different ways. In this situation, we will ask your preference before writing.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、この前のページの続きにしたいです。上下の向きは合っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 前の記録の続きのページを指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I would like it to follow the previous page. Is the top-to-bottom orientation correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Specify the page that continues from the previous entry. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、今は合っています。隣のページとの境目にも文字が重ならない位置を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, it is correct now. We will also check the position so the writing does not overlap the boundary with the neighboring page.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。挟んだ参拝のメモは、先に自分で抜いておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 挟んだ私物のメモを自分で抜くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I will first remove the worship note I tucked inside myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will remove your personal note from the book yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お願いします。書く場所と向きが決まってからお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please do. We will take the book after the writing location and orientation are decided.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: メモを抜きました。この向きのこのページにお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 向きとページの両方を確定して依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have removed the note. Please use this page in this orientation.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm both the orientation and page when making your request. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。指定されたページと向きでお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. We will take it for the specified page and orientation.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: これは温かいそばですか。冷たいそばのあとに、もう一杯来ると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: そば湯を追加の温かいそばかと尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Is this hot soba? I thought another bowl would come after the cold soba.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the soba cooking water is an additional hot soba serving. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 新しいそばではありません。そばをゆでた湯を、つゆと合わせて楽しむ物です。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: It is not a new serving of noodles. It is the water used to cook soba, which you can enjoy mixed with the dipping sauce.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 麺が入っていないのは、入れ忘れではなかったんですね。追加のそばは注文に入っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 麺の入れ忘れではないと理解し注文内容を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: So the lack of noodles was not because someone forgot them. Does my order include additional soba?
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show you understand the noodles were not forgotten, and check the order contents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 追加のご注文は承っていません。今の注文は冷たいそば一人前だけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We have not taken any additional order. Your current order is only one serving of cold soba.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。今は満腹なので追加しません。そば湯はつゆの器に全部注ぐのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 追加せずそば湯の使い方を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I am full now, so I will not order more. Should I pour all the soba water into the sauce bowl?
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not order more; ask how to use soba cooking water. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 全部入れる必要はありません。お好みの量を少しずつ加えられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: You do not need to add it all. You can add your preferred amount a little at a time.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この器は友人の使った物なので、自分の器を使います。友人のつゆと混ぜなくていいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人の器と自分の器を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: This bowl is the one my friend used, so I will use my own. There is no need to mix it with my friend's sauce, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish your friend's bowl from your own. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、ご自分の器でどうぞ。熱いので、ゆっくりお使いください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Correct, please use your own bowl. It is hot, so use it slowly and carefully.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。少しずつ注いで、追加注文はしないまま食事を終えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 少量ずつ使い追加注文なしで食事を終えると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will pour a little at a time and finish my meal without ordering anything extra.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will use small amounts at a time and finish the meal without additional orders. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。追加の注文はありません。ごゆっくりどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. There are no additional orders. Please take your time.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この部屋の清掃は終わりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you finished cleaning this room?

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、清掃済みにしましたが、机の後ろに充電器が残っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 清掃済みの部屋で残された充電器を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, I marked it as cleaned, but there was a charger left behind the desk.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report a charger left in a room marked as cleaned. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 備品か忘れ物か、まだ確認していませんね。見つけた場所と状態を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: You have not yet checked whether it is hotel equipment or lost property, correct? Tell me where and in what condition you found it.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 机の後ろのコンセントに差してありました。どのお客様の物かは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 発見位置を示し持ち主は不明だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: It was plugged into the outlet behind the desk. I do not know which guest it belongs to.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the discovery location and say the owner is unknown. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 持ち主を推測せず、部屋番号と発見時刻を記録しましょう。今はどこに置いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us record the room number and discovery time without guessing the owner. Where is it now?

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだその場所です。自分のポケットに入れたり、隣の部屋へ移したりはしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 物を動かしていない現在の状態を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Still in that location. I have not put it in my pocket or moved it to the next room.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain the current situation: you have not moved the item. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。管理手順に従って担当者が扱います。清掃済みの表示だけで報告が済んだことにはなりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Thank you. The person in charge will handle it under the management procedure. A cleaned indicator alone does not count as reporting it.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。表示を勝手に別の状態へ変えず、発見の報告を別に出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 清掃表示の変更と発見報告を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I will not change the indicator to another status on my own; I will submit a separate discovery report.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish changing the cleaning indicator from reporting the discovery. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。この場面では責任者が備品の確認と忘れ物の受け渡しを判断します。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Correct. In this situation, the supervisor will decide how to check hotel equipment and hand over lost property.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 部屋番号、見つけた場所、時刻を記録し、責任者が確認するまでその部屋を案内しないよう伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 必要な記録と部屋の案内保留を責任者へ引き継ぐ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will record the room number, location and time, and tell them not to show guests to that room until the supervisor checks it.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Hand over the required records and the request to hold room assignment to the supervisor. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。報告を受け取り、部屋の扱いも責任者へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will receive the report and hand over the room's handling to the supervisor too.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 振込先の情報はこちらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are these the recipient's bank details?

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。口座番号はこの紙にありますが、支店は空港支店だったと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 支店名が記憶だけであると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. The account number is on this paper, but I think the branch was Airport Branch.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the branch name is based only on your memory. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 「だったと思う」という情報だけで、振込先を決めることはできません。正式な案内はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We cannot determine the transfer destination based only on what you think it was. Do you have official instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 友人からもらった紙には銀行名しかありません。似た支店名を聞いた記憶で補おうとしていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 持参紙の不足と似た名称を推測したことを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: The paper my friend gave me only has the bank name. I was trying to fill in the rest from my memory of hearing a similar branch name.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the missing information on your paper and that you guessed a similar name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受取人に支店名や必要な情報を確認しましょう。今、連絡できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check the branch name and necessary details with the recipient. Can you contact them now?

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: メッセージは送れますが、返事はすぐ来ないかもしれません。確認中は振込を進めないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 相手の返事を待つ間は振込を保留するよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can send a message, but the reply may not come immediately. Please do not proceed with the transfer while I check.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for the transfer to be held while waiting for the recipient's reply. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。入力や受付は保留にします。お急ぎの理由はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Certainly. We will put data entry and acceptance on hold. Is there a reason you are in a hurry?

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日の支払い期限だと聞いています。でも違う口座へ送るより、相手に確認が遅れると伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 期限があっても相手に確認の遅れを連絡すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I was told the payment deadline is today. But rather than send it to the wrong account, I will tell the recipient that confirmation will take longer.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will tell the recipient about the delay in confirming details even though there is a deadline. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その事情も相手に確認してください。窓口で相手の口座を推測して補うことはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check that situation with the recipient too. We cannot guess and fill in their account details at this counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。正式な振込先と期限を確認し、情報がそろってから手続きします。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 正式な情報と期限を確認してから手続きすると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will confirm the official transfer details and deadline and proceed once I have all the information.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to proceed after confirming official details and the deadline. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。本日は振込を実行せず、確認後の手続き方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. We will not execute a transfer today and will explain how to proceed after confirmation.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お客様の券は三時の吹替版ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Your ticket is for the dubbed showing at three, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 字幕版を見るつもりでした。時刻だけ見て、この券を選んでしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 時刻だけを見て吹替版を選んだと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I intended to watch the subtitled version. I chose this ticket after looking only at the time.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you chose the dubbed version after checking only the time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 同じ作品の字幕版は別の回です。まだ入場前でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The subtitled version of the same film is a different showing. Have you entered yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、まだ入っていません。変更できるか、次の字幕版の時刻と一緒に教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 入場前の変更可否と字幕版の時刻を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: No, I have not. Please tell me whether I can change it and the time of the next subtitled showing.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can change the ticket before entry and when the subtitled showing starts. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この場面では空席と券の条件を確認してから変更をご案内します。字幕版は五時です。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: In this situation, we check availability and ticket conditions before advising on changes. The subtitled showing is at five.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 五時だと友人との夕食に間に合いません。変更の確認を待つ前に、友人へ時間を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人との予定を相談するまで変更を保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: At five, I would not make dinner with my friend. Before waiting for the change check, I would like to discuss the time with my friend.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Put the change on hold until you discuss your plans with your friend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。今の券はまだ変更しません。ご連絡の間、案内をお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Certainly. We will not change your ticket yet. Please keep this information while you contact your friend.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人が夕食を遅らせられると言いました。五時の字幕版に空席があるか確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 予定調整後に字幕版の空席確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: My friend said we can have dinner later. Please check whether there are seats for the subtitled showing at five.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: After adjusting your plans, ask for availability at the subtitled showing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 空席があります。差額はなく、今の券と交換する設定です。交換をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: There are seats. There is no price difference, and in this situation we exchange your current ticket. Would you like to exchange it?

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、交換をお願いします。新しい券で作品名、字幕版、五時の三点を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 交換に同意し新券の作品・形式・時刻を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, please exchange it. I will check three things on the new ticket: the film title, subtitled version, and five o'clock.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Agree to the exchange and check the new ticket's film, format and time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。交換後の券をお渡ししますので、三点をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I will hand you the exchanged ticket; please check those three points.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 宛先のこちらの行について、確認してもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: May I check this line of the delivery address?

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。上が住所で、下の「青空ハイツ」は建物名です。別の住所ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 建物名が住所の一部であると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. The address is above, and Aozora Heights below is the building name. It is not another address.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the building name is part of the address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 建物名の前にも郵便番号があり、二つの宛先のように見えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: There is also a postal code before the building name, so it looks like two destinations.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: メモから写す時に、会社の郵便番号まで下に写してしまいました。下の番号は不要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 別の郵便番号を誤って写したと訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: When copying from my notes, I copied my company's postal code below too. The lower code is unnecessary.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Correct the mistake of copying a different postal code. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 書き直す前に、受取人からの正式な住所を確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Before rewriting it, can you check the official address from the recipient?

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、受取人のメッセージがあります。住所と建物名と部屋番号は、全部同じ宛先です。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 受取人の正式な住所で一つの宛先を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, I have the recipient's message. The address, building name and room number are all for one destination.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm a single destination using the recipient's official address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認できましたら、一つの宛先として分かるように新しい封筒へ書き直せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Once confirmed, you can rewrite it on a new envelope so it clearly shows one destination.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 新しい封筒に書きます。今の封筒の中身を移す時、書類を一枚残さないよう確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 新封筒に書き直し中身の移し忘れを確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will write it on a new envelope. When moving the contents from this one, I will check that I do not leave a document behind.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will rewrite on a new envelope and check that no contents are left behind during transfer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お願いします。書き終わったら、古い封筒ではなく新しい方を窓口にお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please do. Once you finish writing, bring the new envelope to the counter rather than the old one.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。正式な住所から一つの宛先を書き、書類の枚数を確認してから出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 宛先と書類の枚数を確認後に発送すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will write one destination from the official address and check the number of documents before handing it over.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to send it after checking the address and document count. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。書き直しが済むまで発送は受け付けず、お待ちします。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-NARITA-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. We will wait without accepting it for dispatch until you finish rewriting.

DLG-SC-EHM-IMABARI-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-EHM-IMABARI-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 見本の布と糸を並べてあります。織り始める前に、気になる点はありますか。
DLG-SC-EHM-IMABARI-001-SHARED-01.translation: The sample fabric and yarn are laid out. Is there anything you are concerned about before starting to weave?

DLG-SC-EHM-IMABARI-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-EHM-IMABARI-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 見本は薄い青ですが、台の糸は少し緑に見えます。これを使ってよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-EHM-IMABARI-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 見本と台の糸の色が違うことを報告して使用してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-EHM-IMABARI-001-SHARED-02.translation: The sample is light blue, but the yarn on the worktable looks a little green. May I use this?
DLG-SC-EHM-IMABARI-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report the color difference between the sample and worktable yarn, and ask whether it can be used. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-EHM-IMABARI-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-EHM-IMABARI-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: よく気づきました。隣の注文の糸かもしれません。札の番号を読んでもらえますか。
DLG-SC-EHM-IMABARI-001-SHARED-03.translation: Well spotted. It may be yarn for the neighboring order. Could you read the tag number?

DLG-SC-EHM-IMABARI-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-EHM-IMABARI-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 札には二百十四とありますが、私の作業票は二百四十一です。
DLG-SC-EHM-IMABARI-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 札と自分の作業票にある異なる番号を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-EHM-IMABARI-001-SHARED-04.translation: The tag says two hundred fourteen, but my work order says two hundred forty-one.
DLG-SC-EHM-IMABARI-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the different numbers on the tag and your work order. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-EHM-IMABARI-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-EHM-IMABARI-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 番号が違いますね。その糸は動かさず、こちらで正しいものを探します。待つ間は何をする予定でしたか。
DLG-SC-EHM-IMABARI-001-SHARED-05.translation: The numbers differ. Leave that yarn where it is, and we will find the right one. What were you planning to do while waiting?

DLG-SC-EHM-IMABARI-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-EHM-IMABARI-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 端の糸を切るつもりでしたが、使うはさみと切る位置をまだ教わっていません。
DLG-SC-EHM-IMABARI-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: はさみと切る位置をまだ教わっていないと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-EHM-IMABARI-001-SHARED-06.translation: I intended to cut the yarn at the edge, but I have not been taught which scissors to use or where to cut yet.
DLG-SC-EHM-IMABARI-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have not yet been taught which scissors to use or where to cut. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-EHM-IMABARI-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-EHM-IMABARI-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、まだ切らないでください。見本を使って説明しますから、先に作業票の寸法を確かめましょう。
DLG-SC-EHM-IMABARI-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then please do not cut yet. I will explain using the sample, so first let us check the measurements on your work order.

DLG-SC-EHM-IMABARI-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-EHM-IMABARI-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 幅は三十センチと書いてあります。説明を聞いた後、最初の一枚を一緒に確認していただけますか。
DLG-SC-EHM-IMABARI-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 幅を伝えて最初の一枚を職人と確認したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-EHM-IMABARI-001-SHARED-08.translation: It says thirty centimeters wide. After your explanation, could you check the first piece with me?
DLG-SC-EHM-IMABARI-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give the width and ask to check the first piece with the craftsperson. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-EHM-IMABARI-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-EHM-IMABARI-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 最初の一枚は私が見ます。色と寸法を確かめてから、次の分に進んでください。
DLG-SC-EHM-IMABARI-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will inspect the first piece. Check the color and measurements before proceeding to the next pieces.

DLG-SC-EHM-IMABARI-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-EHM-IMABARI-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まず正しい糸を受け取り、切る位置を教わってから、一枚だけ作ってお見せします。
DLG-SC-EHM-IMABARI-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 糸の交換と切る位置の説明を済ませてから一枚作ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-EHM-IMABARI-001-SHARED-10.translation: First I will receive the correct yarn and learn where to cut, then make just one piece and show you.
DLG-SC-EHM-IMABARI-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will make one piece after replacing the yarn and hearing where to cut. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-EHM-IMABARI-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-EHM-IMABARI-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その順番でお願いします。今は見本台へどうぞ。糸を取り替えて戻りますので、またそこでお会いしましょう。
DLG-SC-EHM-IMABARI-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please follow that order. For now, go to the sample table. I will replace the yarn and return, so I will see you there.
